Lue Elizondo Comment on AATIP Slide 9

#ufo #ufotwitter

Statement from Luis "Lue" Elizondo (former head of the Pentagon's AATIP program investigating UAP/UFOs). It focuses on AATIP Slide 9 — one of the infamous slides from the AATIP Program materials that leaked years ago.

That particular slide discusses potential advanced threat capabilities involving:

-Manipulation of physical and cognitive environments

-Penetrating secure facilities

-Influencing decision-makers

-Concepts tied to space-time metric engineering, wormholes, or anomalies that could "bend" space-time

In the clip, Elizondo seems to affirm (or at least not deny) that an adversary (implied to be a foreign nation/states actor) may possess or apply such exotic technology, framing UFOs/UAP not just as unexplained phenomena but potentially as tools/weapons involving space-time manipulation.

My own personal view 

UFOs Unconventional-Aircrafts based on MHD or Field-Resonance propulsion themselves can display all those effects named above.

I already said Americans, Russians and Germans had knowledge on Quantum Field Theory, Quantum Physic and Unified Field Theory at least since 1930s to put that research into real deal into what we call today UFOs or Unconventional Vehicles.
